title: wave_front state snapshot
description: A dated estimate of the current state with provenance (DESIGN.md section 5.1, framework_spec.md section 9). Every variable carries a level, a confidence and the indicators it was read from; only a variable with confidence 'assumed' may have an empty indicator list. The optional builtins section sets the model's built-in variables (pending delayed decisions, last actions, latches, fairness counters; phase 2 decision F2) with the same provenance and a rule. Rates are validated here and are not part of the state.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

date.description: The date the estimate is for, YYYY-MM-DD.

model.description: The model (or model version) the variable names and levels refer to.

variables.description: Declared model variables by name. A variable declared with init=None in the model must be fixed here.

builtins.description: Built-in variables of the model by name (decision F2): pending_<actor>_<action> with the ticks remaining until the delayed effect applies (0 to the action's delay), last_<actor> with an action name or 'none', a latch with one of its levels or 'unset', fair_<name> with its count (0 to the constraint's 'within'). The loader fills them into the state after the variables and refuses a name that is not a settable built-in of the model (tick included) and a value out of range. Declared variables cannot be set here, and built-ins cannot be set in variables.

rates.description: Observed lags and growth caps, by name. Evidence for the rates of the model; they never edit its transition relation.

level.description: A level name for a leveled variable, an integer for a counter, a boolean for a flag.

value.description: A non-negative integer for a pending or fairness counter (and a latch of the tick), an action name or 'none' for a last action, a level name or 'unset' for a latch (a boolean for a latch of a flag).

rule.description: How the value follows from the indicators (for a counter, the arithmetic); with confidence 'assumed', why no indicator supports it.

source.description: Where it was read: a URL or a citation.

observed.description: The date of the observation, YYYY-MM-DD.

rule.description: The mapping rule from the observation to the level.
